changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_floored: the fraction floor on the gc/quarantine-orphans route. Takes the exclusive sweep gate, judges the reaper's floor (whole reapable set at least the minimum and strictly more than the fraction of every stored chunk) with nexus.chunk_is_reapable, refuses with counts and a gc_quarantine_orphans_refused gc_audit row, otherwise calls gc_quarantine_orphans or gc_quarantine_orphans_bounded for the move. No floor given means the move is called untouched.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_floored(int, text, text, text, text, int, int, float8, int, boolean)
